title: Vault secret references
summary: A variable can read its value from an existing HashiCorp Vault secret instead of storing a copy in Windmill. Only the reference is stored, and the value is read from Vault on every access.
body_markdown:
### [Vault secret references](https://www.windmill.dev/changelog/vault-secret-references)


[Enterprise](https://www.windmill.dev/pricing)


Instance settings


[v1.856.0](https://github.com/windmill-labs/windmill/releases/tag/v1.856.0)


[Docs](https://www.windmill.dev/docs/core_concepts/variables_and_secrets#vault-secret-references)


A variable can read its value from an existing HashiCorp Vault secret instead of storing a copy in Windmill. Only the reference is stored, and the value is read from Vault on every access.


#### New features


- New Vault reference type for variables, with a Vault path and an optional key; without a key, the whole secret is read as a JSON object.
- Superadmins allow Vault path prefixes per workspace from Instance settings > Secret Storage > External secret references.
- References reuse the Vault secret backend connection or use their own, with AppRole, JWT auth or a static token.
- AppRole authentication for the Vault secret backend, with the secret_id read from the VAULT_APPROLE_SECRET_ID environment variable.
